title: Factory phase
description: One row of the canonical CodeSense SDLC, authored in phases.yml. The factory playbook (factory-playbook.html) and the arc H content pages both render from it. A build-time check validates both consumers reference the same keys declared here.

phase.description: 1-based phase number in the canonical SDLC.

group.description: The macro group this phase belongs to.

skill.description: Primary skill (installed slash command / BMad skill) that drives this phase.

mcpTools.description: MCP tools the phase's agent calls.

inboxRole.description: Inbox role this phase listens on.

trigger.description: How the phase is kicked off: by hand, or by its routine's trigger (a schedule or one of the routine event kinds).

dashboard.description: Primary dashboard that visualises this phase's state.

agentYaml.description: Pasteable agent.yaml snippet (frontmatter plus body) demonstrating the phase.

routineYml.description: Pasteable routine.yml snippet (or 'n/a' for manual phases).

whatGoesWrong.description: Common failure mode plus the escalation path.

workedExample.description: What the phase's agent actually wrote in the sample epic. Keeps the phase grounded in a real artifact.
